deploy-bot: starting deploy 'schema-migrate/add_user_flags' to prod in 5m. canary 2 hosts, backfill job m-7782, hold_on_lock=true. ping @maria for oncall

maria: oncall here. which shard(s) are in the canary?

jonathan: touches users table + user_flags backfill. plan: add column nullable, deploy app, run backfill job, then ALTER to set NOT NULL. avoiding long locks - backfill via async job.

sasha: last time backfill spiked replicas. recommend rate_limit=50 qps, batch_size=500, sleep_ms=20. also enable deploybot flag 'quiesce-window' so we can hold after backfill.

maria: setting holdpoint after step 3 (post-backfill alter). if any lock > 45s abort and rollback to v1.2.3.

deploy-bot: canary started: hosts us-west-2a/us-west-2b. canary status: 2/2 healthy. kicking off backfill job m-7782 now.

ops-bot: tailing logs: https://logs.redwood.example/backfill/m-7782 (watching errors and lock durations)

kevin: backfill progress: 12% after 12m. current throughput lower than expected. ETA ~1h30 at current rate.

jonathan: curious — are we seeing any lock escalation from the job?

ops-bot: metric alert: users.table.lock_wait_seconds avg=35s over 1m window, spike on writer node-23.

kevin: that's creeping up. suggest we throttle more. I'll lower batch_size to 200 and add sleep_ms=50.

emma: toggled backfill params: batch_size=200, sleep_ms=50, rate_limit=30. requeued m-7782.

maria: enabling deploybot holdpoint now. once backfill completes, hold for manual approve before ALTER NOT NULL.

deploy-bot: holdpoint reached: backfill marked 'complete' by job m-7782. proceeding to step: apply NOT NULL constraint.

sasha: :warning: WAIT — ALTER TABLE trying to set NOT NULL will take an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. last time this blocked replicas for minutes. we should VALIDATE CONSTRAINT asynchronously instead.

jonathan: hmm. migration script did the two-step in one go. that's the bug. we should instead: 1) add nullable column, 2) backfill, 3) ALTER ADD CONSTRAINT NOT NULL USING a CHECK and VALIDATE.

deploy-bot: migration attempt logged: "ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN flags SET NOT NULL" -> lock acquired, blocking replica replay. lock duration 2m and increasing.

sasha: :alarm: blocking lock on users for 2m. maria, do we force-cancel?

maria: abort now. policy is lock>45s -> abort. initiate rollback and revert canary routing.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated. running: `deploybot rollback --to v1.2.3 --reason "blocking lock on users"`

ops-bot: rollback in progress. cancelling migration job m-7782, reverting traffic.

deploy-bot: migration job m-7782 cancelled; traffic rolled back to v1.2.3. db locks released.

ops-bot: rollback complete. no customer-facing errors observed. small spike in retry errors for internal ingestion during canary revert — monitoring.

jonathan: root cause: migration script attempted to set NOT NULL in same deploy step before backfill validation. follow-up: split into explicit steps and add guard that prevents ALTER if backfill age < 24h or if lock_wait > 30s.

emma: I'll open ticket and schedule a controlled reattempt in a low-traffic window (03:00 PT). also adding circuit-breaker to abort migration if any table lock exceeds 30s.

maria: thanks. mark this release as aborted and update release notes + notify product. add retrospective blurb for playbook. :thumbsup:

jonathan: quick note for postmortem: add automated preflight check that validates ALTER path is a metadata-only op on current PG version, otherwise require explicit human approval.

sasha: agree. also add a small runbook snippet for backfill throttling knobs we can flip via deploybot flags.

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot. thread_ts 4166008888.
